cases.sentence: ___. Крестьянин, торжествуя, на дровнях обновляет путь
cases.translation: Winter. The peasant, triumphant, breaks a new path on his sledge
cases.explain: Зима stands alone as the naming subject of the scene, so it takes the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Служанки со всего ___ про барышень своих гадали
cases.translation: Maidservants from the whole household told fortunes about their young ladies
cases.explain: The preposition со (a form of с, meaning 'from') governs the genitive case, so двор becomes двора.

cases.translation: She rides alone across the fields
cases.explain: The preposition по expressing movement across governs the dative plural, so поле becomes полям.

cases.sentence: С ее холодною красою любила русскую ___
cases.translation: With her cold beauty, she loved the Russian winter
cases.explain: Зиму is the direct object of the transitive verb любила (loved), so it takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Татьяна на широкий ___ в открытом платьице выходит
cases.translation: Tatiana goes out into the wide yard in a light dress
cases.explain: The preposition на expressing motion into an open space governs the accusative, so двор stays двор.

cases.translation: Under the down pillow lies a maiden's little mirror
cases.explain: The preposition под (under) governs the instrumental case, so подушка becomes подушкой.

cases.translation: With the family of Panfil Kharlikov
cases.explain: The preposition с meaning 'with' governs the instrumental case, so семья becomes семьей.
The preposition в indicating a time period requires the prepositional case, so январь becomes январе.

reading.ru: В тот год осенняя погода стояла долго на дворе.
reading.question: What unusual weather pattern opens this chapter?
options: Autumn weather lingered for a long time that year
There was a severe drought all autumn
A great flood covered the fields
reading.correct: Autumn weather lingered for a long time that year
reading.explain: The chapter opens noting that 'autumn weather stood long' that year, delaying winter's arrival.

reading.ru: Снег выпал только в январе, на третье в ночь.
reading.question: When did the first snow finally fall?
options: Only in January, on the night of the third
It never actually snowed that year
reading.correct: Only in January, on the night of the third
reading.explain: The text specifies the snow 'fell only in January, on the night of the third.'

reading.ru: Проснувшись рано, в окно увидела Татьяна поутру побелевший двор
reading.question: What does Tatiana see through her window upon waking early?
options: A yard that had turned white with snow
reading.correct: A yard that had turned white with snow
reading.explain: Waking early, Tatiana sees through the window 'the yard turned white' with fresh snow.

reading.ru: Зима. Крестьянин, торжествуя, на дровнях обновляет путь.
reading.question: How does the peasant react to the arrival of winter?
options: Triumphantly, breaking a new path with his sledge
With dread, refusing to go outside
By complaining loudly about the cold
reading.correct: Triumphantly, breaking a new path with his sledge
reading.explain: The text describes the peasant 'triumphant,' breaking a new sledge-path in the snow.

reading.ru: Татьяна, русская душой, сама не зная почему, с ее холодную красою любила русскую зиму.
reading.question: What does the narrator say about Tatiana's feelings toward Russian winter?
options: Being Russian in soul, she loved Russian winter without knowing quite why
She despised the cold weather intensely
She had never experienced a Russian winter before
She only loved winter because of Onegin
reading.correct: Being Russian in soul, she loved Russian winter without knowing quite why
reading.explain: The narrator says Tatiana, 'Russian in soul,' loved Russian winter's cold beauty without knowing why.

reading.ru: По старине торжествовали в их доме эти вечера.
reading.question: How does the Larin household treat the traditional Yuletide evenings?
options: They celebrated them in the old traditional manner
They replaced them with Moscow customs
They celebrated only Tatiana's birthday instead
reading.correct: They celebrated them in the old traditional manner
reading.explain: The text says these evenings were celebrated in their house 'according to the old ways.'

reading.ru: Служанки со всего двора про барышень своих гадали
reading.question: What were the maidservants doing regarding the young ladies of the house?
reading.correct: Telling fortunes about them
reading.explain: The text says the maidservants from the whole household 'told fortunes about their young ladies.'

reading.ru: Татьяна верила преданиям простонародной старины
reading.question: What did Tatiana believe in, according to the narrator?
options: The legends and traditions of common folk antiquity
Only the teachings of the church
reading.correct: The legends and traditions of common folk antiquity
reading.explain: The narrator states 'Tatiana believed in the legends of common folk antiquity,' including omens and fortune-telling.

reading.ru: Жеманный кот на печке сидя, мурлыча лапкой рыльца мыл, то несомненный знак ей был, что едут гости.
reading.question: What omen does Tatiana observe involving a cat?
options: A cat washing its face on the stove, a sure sign that guests are coming
A black cat crossing her path
A cat scratching at the door
reading.correct: A cat washing its face on the stove, a sure sign that guests are coming
reading.explain: The text describes the affected cat washing its face on the stove as 'a certain sign' that guests were coming.

reading.ru: Настали святки. То-то радость
reading.question: What festive season arrives, bringing great joy?
reading.correct: Yuletide (Svyatki)
reading.explain: The text announces 'Yuletide has come. What joy,' marking the festive fortune-telling season.

reading.ru: Татьяна любопытным взором На воск потопленный глядит
reading.question: What fortune-telling method involving melted wax does Tatiana try?
options: Gazing curiously at wax dropped into water
reading.correct: Gazing curiously at wax dropped into water
reading.explain: The text describes Tatiana gazing curiously at wax that had been melted and dropped into water, a folk divination method.

reading.ru: Татьяна на широкий двор В открытом платьице выходит
reading.question: What does Tatiana do in a light dress as part of her fortune-telling rituals?
options: She goes out into the wide yard
She runs to the village church
reading.correct: She goes out into the wide yard
reading.explain: The text describes Tatiana going out into the wide yard in a light dress, seeking omens by moonlight.

reading.ru: Татьяна поясок шелковый сняла, Разделась и в постель легла
reading.question: What does Tatiana do before her famous dream, following folk custom?
options: She removes her silk sash, undresses, and lies down in bed
She stays awake all night reading
She goes riding in the snow
She writes another letter to Onegin
reading.correct: She removes her silk sash, undresses, and lies down in bed
reading.explain: The text says she removed her silk sash, undressed, and lay down in bed, per the fortune-telling ritual.

reading.ru: И снится чудный сон Татьяне.
reading.question: What happens to Tatiana once she falls asleep?
options: She has a wondrous, strange dream
She has a nightmare about her wedding
reading.correct: She has a wondrous, strange dream
reading.explain: The text announces 'and Tatiana dreams a wondrous dream,' introducing the famous dream sequence.

reading.ru: Большой взъерошенный медведь.
reading.question: What creature emerges from the snowdrift in Tatiana's dream to help her cross a stream?
reading.correct: A large, shaggy bear
reading.explain: The text describes 'a large, shaggy bear' emerging from beneath the snowdrift in her dream.

reading.ru: Она бежит. Он все во след.
reading.question: What does Tatiana do after the bear carries her, and how does the bear behave?
options: She runs, and the bear follows right behind
She stops and confronts the bear
She falls asleep in the snow
She climbs a tree to escape
reading.correct: She runs, and the bear follows right behind
reading.explain: The text says 'she runs. He follows right behind,' describing the pursuit in her dream.

reading.ru: Вдруг междерев шалаш убогой.
reading.question: What structure does Tatiana suddenly see among the trees in her dream?
reading.correct: A humble hut/shack
reading.explain: The text describes 'suddenly, among the trees, a humble shack,' where the bear takes her.

reading.ru: Но что подумала Татьяна, Когда узнала меж гостей Того, кто мил и страшен ей, Героя нашего романа?
reading.question: Whom does Tatiana recognize among the monstrous guests inside the hut?
options: Onegin, the hero of the novel, dear and terrifying to her
reading.correct: Onegin, the hero of the novel, dear and terrifying to her
reading.explain: The text reveals that among the monsters, Tatiana recognizes 'the one who is dear and terrible to her,' our hero Onegin.

reading.ru: Он там хозяин, это ясно.
reading.question: What role does Onegin appear to play among the monstrous guests in the dream?
options: He is clearly the host/master there
He is a random guest, unnoticed
reading.correct: He is clearly the host/master there
reading.explain: The text observes 'he is the master there, that is clear,' as all the creatures obey him.

reading.ru: И Таня в ужасе проснулась.
reading.question: How does Tatiana's dream end?
options: She never wakes up in the narrative
She wakes up to find it was not a dream
reading.correct: She wakes up in terror
reading.explain: The chaotic dream ends abruptly: 'and Tanya woke up in terror.'

reading.ru: то был друзья Мартын Задека, глава халдейских мудрецов, гадатель, толкователь снов.
reading.question: What book does Tatiana consult to interpret her dream?
reading.correct: Martyn Zadeka's dream-interpretation book
reading.explain: The text identifies the book as by 'Martyn Zadeka,' a fortune-teller and interpreter of dreams.

reading.ru: С утра дом Лариной гостями весь полон.
reading.question: What happens at the Larin house on the morning of Tatiana's name day?
options: The house fills entirely with guests
Everyone leaves for church at dawn
The house is closed to visitors
reading.correct: The house fills entirely with guests
reading.explain: The text says that from morning, 'the Larins' house is entirely full of guests' arriving for the name-day party.

reading.ru: Вдруг к двери Настя Шленский входит, И с ним Онегин.
reading.question: Who arrives suddenly at the party, alongside Lensky?
reading.correct: Onegin
reading.explain: The text announces that Lensky enters, 'and with him Onegin,' causing a stir among the guests.

reading.ru: Кружится вальса вихрь шумный, Чета мелькает за четой.
reading.question: What is happening on the dance floor as the ball proceeds?
options: The noisy whirl of the waltz spins, couple flashing past couple
Everyone has stopped to eat dinner
reading.correct: The noisy whirl of the waltz spins, couple flashing past couple
reading.explain: The text describes 'the noisy whirl of the waltz' spinning, with couples flashing past one another.

reading.ru: Пистолетов пара. Две пули. Больше ничего.
reading.question: What does Lensky demand at the chapter's dramatic close, after Onegin flirts with Olga?
options: A pair of pistols and two bullets, nothing more
To dance with Olga one more time
reading.correct: A pair of pistols and two bullets, nothing more
reading.explain: The chapter ends with Lensky demanding a horse and pistols: 'a pair of pistols, two bullets, nothing more,' setting up the duel.
